ndlgvcsga.speaker: Sign
ndlgvcsga.text: PEOPLE'S SPACE PROGRAM. RESTRICTED AREA. The Americans have their NASA. We have bamboo, and the Moon is closer from the jungle.

ndlgvcega.speaker: Chief Engineer
ndlgvcega.text: Do not touch anything. Especially the drum. Especially the OTHER drum. You are here about the launch?

choices.text: Is that rocket made of bamboo?

ndlgvcegb.speaker: Chief Engineer
ndlgvcegb.text: Bamboo is light, strong, and grows back by Tuesday. Steel does not grow back by Tuesday.

ndlgvcege.speaker: Chief Engineer
ndlgvcege.text: Heat shield. My grandmother wove it. If it can keep off the monsoon, it can keep off space.

ndlgvcegc.speaker: Chief Engineer
ndlgvcegc.text: The Moon. VC-0 went into the hill, but VC-0 was a test. VC-1 has more fuel. Much, much more fuel.

ndlgvcegf.speaker: Chief Engineer
ndlgvcegf.text: The monkey. The man by the monkey THINKS it is him. Do not tell him.

ndlgvcegg.speaker: Chief Engineer
ndlgvcegg.text: The plunger is out by the pad. When the countdown is done, someone must push it. Not me. I have a family.

ndlgvcegd.speaker: Chief Engineer
ndlgvcegd.text: Then you will have to get past the whole ministry of rockets. GUARDS!

ndlgvcqma.speaker: Quartermaster
ndlgvcqma.text: The program buys only the best. From the Americans, mostly. They leave it lying around.

ndlgvcpla.speaker: Pilot
ndlgvcpla.text: I was VOLUNTEERED. First human on the Moon! They are training me with the monkey. The monkey is doing very well.

choices.text: Want to get out of here?

ndlgvcplb.speaker: Pilot
ndlgvcplb.text: He has done forty launches in the cage. I have done none. He is the senior pilot.

ndlgvcplc.speaker: Pilot
ndlgvcplc.text: Thank you! Take my rations. They give the monkey my rations anyway.

ndlgvcpld.speaker: Pilot
ndlgvcpld.text: ...Yes. Yes I do. I will cover you. Let the monkey have the Moon.
